about_the_game:
As AI technology advanced, it became an essential operating system integrated into every product, transforming human life in unimaginable ways.

"Can you survive without AI?"

Under this bold slogan, companies raced to develop their own versions of AI. But the competition bred flawed and reckless AI systems, leading to a new social crisis—intelligent machines turning against each other in heated conflict.

This phenomenon soon became known as “AI SHOCK.”

Amidst the chaos, Judy, the only daughter of Glory Electronics, found herself struggling with even the simplest tasks—she couldn't even order a pizza! Determined to reclaim convenience and restore order, she embarks on a daring journey into the heart of danger.

Gear up and jump into your mech in this action-packed top-down shooter!

Battle against rogue robots in intense combat. Gather 37 weapons, upgrade your arsenal, and prepare for escalating chaos—because enemy machines level up too and they won’t hold back!

If you're ready for the ultimate shooting mayhem, consider this your official invitation.

Mech activation complete—GO TIME!

🔥 Never give up, never surrender! 🔥

Game Modes

🔥 Story Mode The future is in ruins, devastated by rampaging rogue robots. Enter one brave girl—ready to fight back and save the world… A totally! Totally! Ordinary storyline. (Yep, nothing groundbreaking here.) 😆

🛡️ Survival Mode Upgrade your weapons, gear up, and prepare for the ultimate showdown—because when the time runs out, it’s you vs. the boss in an all-out battle for survival!

Alright, pilot—MECH ENGAGED! LET'S GO! 🚀

Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 16.04 LTS
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-3570
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 970 or better
  • Storage: 10 MB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7700 or AMD Ryzen 2500X
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
